---
name: Bug report
about: Reproduce an incorrect result or unexpected error
---

Describe the expected and actual behavior. Include Fieldkin and Rust versions,
configuration, and a minimal synthetic pair of schemas. Do not include private
sample data. Explain why the expected correspondence is correct in your domain.

For performance bugs, include input sizes, sample lengths, hardware, toolchain,
and a reproducible benchmark. For ambiguous results, include the signal report.
